messages:
emma: heads up — ap-southeast1 showing a chained eviction pattern since 04:10 UTC. lots of tiny-gang pods evicted after a maintenance drain kicked off
rafael: noticed that. maintenance was supposed to be network switch reboot in rack-14, not cluster-wide. nodes started showing NotReady while drain was running
priya: can you share node list? wondering if taints/affinity amplified the effect
emma: affected nodes: gpu-node-apse1-{12,13,14,15,16} 
infra-bot: maintenance: rack-14-switch-reboot scheduled by netops@redwood at 04:05 UTC (change-id: maint-2026-04-01-21)
zack: why did autoscaler trigger scale-down during a maintenance window? it should be suspended during scheduled ops
priya: good catch. our maintenance-mode toggle didn't propagate to all regions because the orchestration job hit a timeout; only partial suspension applied
emma: pasted pod snippet:```
$ kubectl get pods -n ml -o wide | grep Evicted
job-small-21  0/1 Evicted  0  12m gpu-node-apse1-12
job-small-22  0/1 Evicted  0  11m gpu-node-apse1-13
```
rafael: root cause looks like a confluence: partial maintenance + autoscaler active + affinity for gpu-anchored pods -> nodes drained concurrently -> scheduler preempted tiny-gang workloads onto already busy nodes -> cascading evictions
ops-bot: alert: during maintenance, autoscaler performed scaleDown 8 -> 3 in ap-southeast1 (policy: default).
zack: mitigation: paused autoscaler for ap-southeast1 and increased warmpool-min from 2 -> 6 for 45m. this should absorb the jitter while netops finishes the switch reboot
priya: cost note: 45m bump ~= +$6k projected for Dedicated commit. keeping it short to limit impact
emma: netops confirms switch came back at 04:28 UTC and is monitoring. will keep maintenance window flagged until 05:00 UTC
rafael: next steps: 1) fail-safe to fully suspend autoscaler on scheduled maintenance; 2) ensure maintenance-mode handshake has stronger retry/backoff so partial applies don't happen; 3) add scheduler check to avoid scale-down if nodes have gpu-anchored pods
zack: i'll open INFRA-551 for autoscaler suspend safety and AUTOSCALE-551 for predicate check. assigning to priya and rafael
priya: also recommend an alert: "scale-down during maintenance window" to catch this early
emma: job owners affected: 9901, 9902, 9903 — recommend checkpoint resume where available
rafael: final recap: cause = partial maintenance + active autoscaler + affinity constraints -> node drains + preempts; mitigation = autoscaler pause + warmpool bump + netops rollback/hard-check; follow-ups created
ops-bot: INFRA-551 created (autoscaler suspend safety).
